```{r setup, include=FALSE}
require(readtext)
require(dplyr)
require(ggplot2)
require(forcats)
require(tidyr)
require(ggridges)
```

```{r}
# loading data 
lyceums <- read.csv("Education/ranks 2016 2018 2019 2022 2024 2026.csv")
```

# Grades

```{r}
# Making macro-regions
lyceums$Macro.Region <- fct_collapse(lyceums$Region, 
                               North = c("BRICENI", "EDINEŢ", "DONDUŞENI", "DROCHIA", "FĂLEŞTI", "FLOREŞTI", "GLODENI", "OCNIŢA", "RÎŞCANI", "SÎNGEREI", "SOROCA"),
                               South = c("CANTEMIR", "CIMIŞLIA", "CĂUŞENI", "ŞTEFAN VODĂ", "BASARABEASCA", "CAHUL", "LEOVA", "TARACLIA", "BĂLŢI"),
                               Centre = c("ŞOLDĂNEŞTI", "STRĂŞENI", "REZINA", "TELENEŞTI", "ORHEI", "CRIULENI", "ANENII NOI", "IALOVENI", "HÎNCEŞTI", "NISPORENI", "UNGHENI", "CĂLĂRAŞI"),
                               Chișinău = c("CHIŞINĂU"),
                               Găgăuzia = c("UTA GĂGĂUZIA"),
                               Transnistria = c("DUBĂSARI", "TIRASPOL", "BENDER", "GRIGORIOPOL", "RÎBNIŢA"))

```

## Descriptives

```{r}

lyceums %>%
  group_by(Macro.Region) %>%
  summarise(
    weighted_mean = weighted.mean(Average.grade, w = Total.candidates),
    unweighted_mean = mean(Average.grade),
    n_schools = n(),
    total_students = sum(Total.candidates),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

lyceums %>%
  group_by(Language) %>%
  summarise(
    weighted_mean = weighted.mean(Average.grade, w = Total.candidates),
    unweighted_mean = mean(Average.grade),
    n_schools = n(),
    total_students = sum(Total.candidates),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


lyceums %>%
  group_by(Type) %>%
  summarise(
    weighted_mean = weighted.mean(Average.grade, w = Total.candidates),
    unweighted_mean = mean(Average.grade),
    n_schools = n(),
    total_students = sum(Total.candidates),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```

## Regional summary
```{r}
# creating a regional summary

regional_lyceums <- lyceums %>%
  group_by(Region, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    weighted_mean = weighted.mean(Average.grade, w = Total.candidates),
    unweighted_mean = mean(Average.grade),
    n_schools = n(),
    total_students = sum(Total.candidates),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```


```{r}
# dispersion by region

regional_dispersion <- lyceums %>%
  group_by(Region, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    sd_mark = sd(Average.grade),
    iqr_mark = IQR(Average.grade),
    cv = sd(Average.grade) / mean(Average.grade),   
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
# joining data

regional_full <- regional_lyceums %>%
  left_join(regional_dispersion, by = c("Region", "Year"))
```

## Macro-regions
```{r}
# creating a macro regional summary

macro.regional_lyceums <- lyceums %>%
  group_by(Macro.Region, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    weighted_mean = weighted.mean(Average.grade, w = Total.candidates),
    unweighted_mean = mean(Average.grade),
    n_schools = n(),
    total_students = sum(Total.candidates),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```


```{r}
# dispersion by region

macro.regional_dispersion <- lyceums %>%
  group_by(Macro.Region, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    sd_mark = sd(Average.grade),
    iqr_mark = IQR(Average.grade),
    cv = sd(Average.grade) / mean(Average.grade),   
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
# joining data

macro.regional_full <- macro.regional_lyceums %>%
  left_join(macro.regional_dispersion, by = c("Macro.Region", "Year"))
```


#### Plots
```{r}
ggplot(macro.regional_full, aes(x = Year, y = weighted_mean, color = Macro.Region)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(title = "Within-Region Dispersion Over Time",
       y = "SD of School Grade", x = "Year") +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(macro.regional_full, 
       aes(y = weighted_mean, x = Year, color = Macro.Region)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.7) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(lyceums, aes(x = factor(Year), y = Average.grade)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.alpha = 0.4) +
  facet_wrap(~ Macro.Region) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of School Grade by Region and Year",
       x = "Year", y = "Average Grade") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  geom_line(data = national_mean, aes(x = factor(Year), y = nat_mean, group = 1),
            color = "red", alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 0.8, inherit.aes = FALSE) 
```

```{r}
# how many schools in macro regions
lyceums %>%
  group_by(Macro.Region, Year) %>%
  summarise(n_schools = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Year, values_from = n_schools)
```


### Deviation from National mean
```{r}
national_mean <- lyceums %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(nat_mean = weighted.mean(Average.grade, w = Total.candidates), .groups = "drop")
```

```{r}
gap <-  macro.regional_full %>%
  left_join(national_mean, by = "Year") %>%
  mutate(gap = weighted_mean - nat_mean)
```

#### Plot
```{r}
ggplot(gap, aes(x = Year, y = gap, color = Macro.Region)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(title = "Regional Gap from National Average Grade",
       y = "Deviation from National Mean", x = "Year") +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Variance over Time
```{r}
variance <- lyceums %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(
    total_var = var(Average.grade),
    between_var = var(ave(Average.grade, Macro.Region, FUN = mean)),
    within_var = total_var - between_var,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pct_between = between_var / total_var * 100,
    pct_within = within_var / total_var * 100
  )

ggplot(variance, aes(x = Year, y = pct_between)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_smooth(method = lm, color = "darkgrey") +
  labs(title = "Share of Total Inequality: Between Region",
       y = "% of Total Variance", x = "Year") +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Beta-convergence scatter
```{r}
convergence_data <- macro.regional_full %>%
  group_by(Macro.Region) %>%
  summarise(
    start_mark = weighted_mean[Year == min(Year)],
    growth = (weighted_mean[Year == max(Year)] - weighted_mean[Year == min(Year)]) / weighted_mean[Year == min(Year)] * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
ggplot(convergence_data, aes(x = start_mark, y = growth, label = Macro.Region)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "grey40") +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel() +
  labs(title = "Beta-Convergence: Starting Grade vs Growth Rate",
       x = "Starting Average Grade", y = "% Growth Over Period") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(lyceums, aes(x = Average.grade, y = factor(Year), fill = Macro.Region)) +
  geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.6, scale = 1.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ Macro.Region) +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Grades Over Time, by Macro Region", x = "Average Grade", y = "Year") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

## Linguistic Inequality
```{r}
language_lyceums <- lyceums %>%
  group_by(Language, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    weighted_mean = weighted.mean(Average.grade, w = Total.candidates),
    unweighted_mean = mean(Average.grade),
    n_schools = n(),
    total_students = sum(Total.candidates),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
# dispersion by region

language_dispersion <- lyceums %>%
  group_by(Language, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    sd_mark = sd(Average.grade),
    iqr_mark = IQR(Average.grade),
    cv = sd(Average.grade) / mean(Average.grade),   
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
# joining data

language_full <- language_lyceums %>%
  left_join(language_dispersion, by = c("Language", "Year"))
```

```{r}
language_gap <-  language_full %>%
  left_join(national_mean, by = "Year") %>%
  mutate(gap = weighted_mean - nat_mean)

language_gap.ro.rus <- language_gap %>% 
  filter(Language %in% c("Russian", "Romanian", "Bilingual (Romanian, Russian)"))
         
```

#### Plots
```{r}
ggplot(language_gap.ro.rus, aes(x = Year, y = gap, color = Language)) +

  geom_point(size = 2) +
  labs(title = "Language Gap from National Average Grade",
       y = "Deviation from National Mean", x = "Year") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(lyceums, aes(x = factor(Year), y = Average.grade)) +
```

```{r}
ggplot(lyceums, aes(x = factor(Year), y = Average.grade)) +
```

## Language and Macro Regions
```{r}

language_region_lyceums <- lyceums %>%
  group_by(Language, Macro.Region, Year) %>%
  summarise(
    weighted_mean = weighted.mean(Average.grade, w = Total.candidates),
    unweighted_mean = mean(Average.grade),
    n_schools = n(),
    total_students = sum(Total.candidates),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}

language_region_decomp <- lyceums %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(
    total_var = var(Average.grade),
    region_var = var(ave(Average.grade, Macro.Region, FUN = mean)),
    region_lang_var = var(ave(Average.grade, Macro.Region, Language, FUN = mean)),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    pct_region_only = region_var / total_var * 100,
    pct_added_by_language = (region_lang_var - region_var) / total_var * 100,
    pct_within_region_lang = (total_var - region_lang_var) / total_var * 100
  )
```



### Gap
```{r}

language_region_lyceums_gap <-  language_region_lyceums %>%
  filter(Language %in% c("Russian", "Romanian", "Bilingual (Romanian, Russian)")) %>%  
  left_join(national_mean, by = "Year") %>%
  mutate(gap = weighted_mean - nat_mean)

ggplot(language_region_lyceums_gap, aes(x = Year, y = gap, color = Language)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40") +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ Macro.Region) +
  labs(title = "Language Gap from National Average Grade, by Region",
       y = "Deviation from National Mean", x = "Year") +
  theme_minimal()
```

### Model
```{r}

lyceums_no_NA <- na.omit(lyceums)

model <- lm(Average.grade ~ factor(Macro.Region) + factor(Language) + factor(Type) + factor(Year), data = lyceums)

model <- lm(Average.grade ~ Macro.Region * Language + factor(Type) + factor(Year), data = lyceums)

summary(model)

model2 <- lm(Graduation.rate ~ Macro.Region * Language + factor(Type) + factor(Year), data = lyceums)

summary(model2)
```

```{r}
ggplot(language_region_lyceums, aes(x = Year, y = weighted_mean, color = Language)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ Macro.Region) +
  labs(title = "Average Marks by Language of Instruction, by Region, Over Time",
       y = "Weighted Mean Mark", x = "Year") +
  theme_minimal()

```
